cases: The Super Bowl halftime show is one of the most anticipated performances each year, often featuring globally renowned artists. In 2024, how many games did the NFL team from the birthplace of the performer at the 2024 Super Bowl halftime show win? Format your answer as a number.

Authors' birthplaces can influence their storytelling, and natural landmarks often play a role in their narratives. What is the largest lake in the birth state of the author whose novel won the 2024 Goodreads Choice Award for Fiction?
Football stadiums often serve as historic venues for legendary matches and unforgettable moments. In which year was the home stadium of the team that won the 2024 UEFA Champions League inaugurated?

Winning Album of the Year at the Grammy Awards is a major milestone for any artist. What was the release date (in MM/DD/YYYY) of the album that won Album of the Year at the 67th annual Grammy Awards ceremony?

Mayors play a critical role in shaping city policies and governance. Who is the party leader of the political party that the current mayor (as of April 2025) belongs to in the capital city of the country that hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics?
Hollywood's highest-paid actors often headline major animated films with global releases. Where did the animated movie starring Hollywood's highest-paid actor of 2024 first premiere?
